# Attach Mirror Handoff Model

## Core operations
- attach to existing session
- mirror live session into another surface
- hand off from agent to human
- hand off from human to agent
- reattach after interruption
- preserve workstream identity across handoffs

## Why
The workspace should feel persistent and joinable, not like each surface spawns a new disconnected flow.
